CustomField.description: SCRUM-449: Days the Opportunity has been without a USER change. Formelfield, systemberechnet, never writable. Anchor = Last_User_Change__c; until the first evaluation falls back to LastModifiedDate. NULL on closed Opportunities.
CustomField.label: Inactive Days
CustomField.formula: IF(IsClosed, NULL, IF(ISBLANK(Last_User_Change__c), NOW() - LastModifiedDate, NOW() - Last_User_Change__c))
